attack_surface.boundary: verify-then-accept: what runs before a ref, baseline, index, policy or file is accepted from the host, and the paths a key or server address takes through the CLI

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: a fresh clone has nothing to compare with
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: writable and read-only clones refuse a host that moves a branch backwards (--accept-rewind to override)

proposed.fix: UNKNOWN refuses unless --accept-rewind, with the message naming why (offline / limit); raise the default limit for the connectivity walk, which is local objects plus fetched commits
proposed.test: Fixed: an unrelated 60-commit head is refused as 'cannot connect to the last accepted head'

risk_decision.rationale: awaiting the step-4 verification or a fix

vulnerabilities.title: the rewind guard's UNKNOWN verdict (offline, or more than 50 commits of lineage the clone cannot connect) is treated as not-rewound: the pull proceeds and merges with an empty base
